study_design: Experiment 1: current-information PPO vs GNN-PPO; Experiment 2: uniform 0-5-month delay across all 24 nodes
test_forcing_limitation: 2019-2021 are repeated evaluation conditions with repeated-climatology input; they are not independent catchments.

experiment_3.policy: Existing current-information-trained GNN-PPO checkpoints; no retraining.
experiment_3.sector_delay_definition: sector_<water|energy|food>_tauN delays only that sector; every other node remains current.
experiment_3.node_delay_definition: node_<node>_tauN delays exactly one node; every other node remains current.

experiment_4.policy: Existing current-information-trained PPO checkpoints; no retraining.
experiment_4.sector_delay_definition: sector_<water|energy|food>_tauN delays only that sector; every other node remains current.
experiment_4.node_delay_definition: node_<node>_tauN delays exactly one node; every other node remains current.
